method.comovement: Pearson on weekly CHANGES in lots; partials strip ΔOI, which the report's adding-up constraint (Σ long = Σ short = OI) would otherwise impose on every cohort pair.
method.price_response: corr(Δposition, same-week % return of the front contract). Hedgers lean against the move, speculators with it.
method.persistence: AR(1) of the position level and mean |Δ| as a share of the position.
